test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

William Shakespeare and Christopher Marlowe, the two great playwrights of the Elizabethan era, were __living in the same time period.__
solution: The correct answer is '**Contemporaries**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Contemporaries'. • It means 'a person who lives or does something at the same time as somebody else'. (समकालीन व्‍यक्ति) • *Example: The two men were exact **contemporaries** at university. *** Correct Answer:__** *Contemporaries.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Chauvinist**: a person displaying aggressive or exaggerated patriotism. (आक्रामक या अतिरंजित देशभक्ति प्रदर्शित करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Cosmopolitan**: containing people from all over the world. (विश्‍व के विभिन्‍न भागों से आए व्‍यक्तियों वाला; सर्वदेशीय) • **Cynic**: a person who believes that people only do things for themselves, rather than to help others. (व्‍यक्ति जो सबको स्‍वार्थी समझता हो; दोषदर्शी) 48:Tbfa, The correct answer is '**Foolish**'.
